suggestions.description: Raw card data exposed, violating PCI-DSS
suggestions.before: export interface PaymentDetails { cardNumber, expiryDate, cvv }
suggestions.after: export interface PaymentRequest { paymentMethodId, amount, currency }
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates PCI-DSS violations and delegates to processors

suggestions.description: Missing transaction management between charge and subscription
suggestions.after: Wrap in database transaction with commit/rollback
suggestions.benefits: Ensures atomicity and prevents inconsistent state

refactorings.summary: Requires critical refactoring for PCI-DSS compliance and production readiness.

recommendations.description: Payment card data stored in plain text without encryption, violating PCI-DSS compliance. Must integrate PCI-compliant processor (Stripe/Square) with tokenization.
Card validation lacks Luhn algorithm, allowing invalid cards to pass. Implement proper validation or delegate to payment processor.
Zero test coverage for all business-critical functions. Add comprehensive tests for payment flows, validation, and subscription state transitions.
Payment processing lacks transactional atomicity. If subscription update fails after charge succeeds, system enters inconsistent state.
Expiry date parsing assumes year 2000+, rejecting valid future cards. Fix year calculation or use date-fns library.
Multiple JSON.parse calls without error handling will crash on malformed data. Add try-catch blocks.
